cardPool.title: Card Pool
cardPool.intro: Browse the official and custom catalog, compare statistics and abilities, and open technical tools only when needed.
cardPool.previewHint: Card, statistics, and abilities are aligned; technical data remains in the Debug panel.
cardPool.galleryHint: Lightweight renderer thumbnails: scroll, tap, or click to select.
cardPool.catalogHint: Read-only: a detailed table as an alternative to the gallery.

deckBuilder.title: Build a deck
deckBuilder.intro: F9S1c1 integrates the official 50-deck roster and streamlines building with unified copy controls, a named library, and immediate ENE-curve analysis.
deckBuilder.includeCustom: Include CUSTOM cards in the pool
deckBuilder.availableHint: Select a name to view details; loading it into the draft remains a separate action.
deckBuilder.importTextHelp: Paste the full contents of the .json file exported by Arena Rubra. Do not enter a file path or address: this must be the complete JSON text, including its opening and closing braces.
deckBuilder.customPoolHelp: The CUSTOM toggle adds cards saved in the Card Editor to the pool. Decks with custom cards are saved as UNOFFICIAL.
deckBuilder.cardPreviewHint: Click a card in the draft or pool. The renderer uses local frames/placeholders and also shows expected asset paths.
deckBuilder.analysisLabel: Analysis of the deck being built
deckBuilder.customWarning: this draft contains {count} CUSTOM card(s). It can only be used in the custom lab and does not modify the official roster.
deckBuilder.rosterRules: {size}-card deck; optional Mission, maximum 1; maximum 1 Commander, Pivot, and each Elite; maximum {copies} copies of other cards; the fifteen Starter cards remain excluded from the deck.
deckBuilder.draftRoles: Draft roles: Commander {commander}, base {base}, heavy {heavy}, Elite {elite}, Pivot {pivot}, tactics {tactics}, Missions {missions}.
deckBuilder.emptyDraft: The deck draft is empty. Add cards from the legal pool.

controlCenter.mapsIntro: Review geometry, players, the central SP, and validation; from here you can start Setup or open an editable copy in the Editor.
controlCenter.statsIntro: A concise view of persistent competitive records. Tutorial and Match Lab sessions are excluded.
controlCenter.historyIntro: Complete archive of outcomes with setup, final statistics, attribution, and telemetry when available.
controlCenter.buildIdentityIntro: Metadata read from the single BUILD_INFO source; no labels are duplicated in the Control Center.
controlCenter.buildNotes: Arena Rubra development build with the official roster, Player tools, and separate diagnostics.
controlCenter.preferencesIntro: Settings are saved in local storage and reuse the existing audio, SFX, card-animation, and token-FX runtimes.
controlCenter.reducedMotion: The system reduced-motion preference continues to take priority over nonessential effects.
controlCenter.developerModeHint: It is enabled by default in this development candidate. Future public builds can disable it and hide Debug.
controlCenter.archiveIntro: Export or restore a versioned backup of custom cards, decks, maps, statistics, history, settings, tutorial progress, and local labs.
controlCenter.exportArchiveIntro: Create a portable JSON file containing all {count} keys recognized by the local vault.
controlCenter.importArchiveIntro: A safety backup is created before restoration. Unknown keys are ignored.
controlCenter.invalidEntries: The backup does not contain a valid entries dictionary.
controlCenter.noKnownKeys: No recognized Arena Rubra keys were found in the backup.
